android.desc:
Namaste!

Sanskruti - Read Bhagavad Gita is an ad-free, easy to use, well-designed mobile application to read The Srimad Bhagavad Gita. With curated Verse of the Day, read a new verse every day. Now you can easily navigate between chapters and verses with our simple design. Like a verse? Add it to your Bookmarks.

Sanskruti.co strives to make classical Indian literature accessible to the masses. To begin with, we have created a well designed, simple app to read the holy text Srimad Bhagavad Gita. Help us achieve our mission.

★ Ad-free experience
★ (NEW) Indian languages support - Hindi, Marathi
★ Daily curated verses with Verse of the Day
★ Simple navigation
★ Save favourite Verses using Bookmarks
★ Continue reading where you left off
★ (NEW) Track chapter-wise and overall reading progress
★ (NEW) Dark mode for strain-free night time reading
★ (NEW) Increase or decrease font size as per your convenience

We read all your comments. Please provide your valuable feedback at namaste@sanskruti.co
